title: Battery Good, Starter Good, Crank Still Slow
topic: Starting-circuit resistance can cause slow cranking even when battery and starter are serviceable
mechanicTruth: A healthy battery and starter still depend on low-resistance cables and connections; corrosion, looseness, or cable damage can create voltage drop under cranking load.
